description: The file contains a test class named DurationTest which includes unit tests for the Duration class, focusing on adding time to dates based on different units (seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, years, recurring intervals) and testing related methods like getCode. It uses JUnit 5 with some OpenMRS-specific utilities and tests exception handling.

classes.name: DurationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class validating the behavior of the Duration class, including date calculations and code retrieval based on Concept mappings.
